cost_model.units: seconds of native task time per point on one thread (J-SWEEP-1, 16-thread NUMA lanes, --mp-check on)

promotions.source: graph_costs.csv + graph_promotions.csv of the L7/L8 groups (J-SWEEP-1, both campaigns, 2 x 512 points)

provenance: C8(3) Stage 4a profiling fixtures (tools/prepare_benchmarks.py --order 8); never a physical result; their seeds are not campaign seeds.
seed_rule: native/net seed of a block: SHA-256('c8-d3-bench|<seed>|<block>|native'/'net'), first 8 bytes LE mod 2^63; uniform draws: ids sorted by SHA-256('c8-d3-bench|<seed>|<draw>|<id>')

p4_L8.fraction_rule: --fraction F keeps the first ceil(F x k) graphs of each sector in draw order (both replicates)
